Buildings and boats along the Ushuaia waterfront, with forest and mountains behind them, Argentina
Ushuaia: waterfront houses beneath the mountain slopes of Tierra del Fuego

## How the day unfolds




The trip starts in Ushuaia in the morning. The drive to Puerto Almanza is part of the experience, with views of valleys, mountains, water and southern forests along the way. The route includes stops at Lake Victoria and the well-known Flag Tree.




In Puerto Almanza, you will meet local fishers, learn about their work and see how they prepare to head out on the water. You then take a boat to the fishing grounds. This part of the trip lasts about 25 minutes, during which the traps are hauled up and red king crabs are collected.




Back on shore, lunch is served at the fishers' restaurant. The three-course meal includes Beagle Dip, king crab and dessert. A soft drink and a glass of wine or craft beer are also included in the price.




After lunch, you return to Ushuaia, stopping at viewpoints along the way to take photographs.

## Schedule




- 08:30 - Departure from the hotels.
- 09:30 - Lake Victoria.
- 10:10 - The Flag Tree, or “árbol bandera”.
- 10:40 - Arrival in Puerto Almanza.
- 11:00 - Boat trip and red king crab harvesting, approximately 25 minutes.
- 12:00 - Lunch.
- 14:30 - Return to Ushuaia with stops at viewpoints.
- 16:30 - Arrival in Ushuaia.

## Additional information




You may share the restaurant with other passengers. It seats up to 20 people.




The programme depends on the weather, particularly wind conditions. It is unsuitable for minors and people with limited mobility. Waterproof footwear is required.
